_note: Endpoints and store pages used by the collectors. 'verified' must be set to true by hand after you confirm, during the week 3 five-title test, that the endpoint works and its terms allow automated access. Collectors refuse to run a source whose 'terms_allow_automation' is not true.

ios.chart_note: Apple's legacy iTunes RSS top-grossing feed, games genre (6014). Apple has retired some legacy feeds; if this returns nothing, use a chart tracker export (see config/README.md).

steam.chart_note: Steam's weekly top sellers by country. Record chart_scope = 'country' when country_code is honoured, otherwise 'global'.
